LanguageData.WotF_ElvenApronDress.description: A roomy everyday elven apron dress with waist pockets stitched for tools and cuttings. It stays neat and out of the way, making tending and harvesting crops easier.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenApronDress.label: elven apron dress
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenDressTraditional_I.description: A one-piece elven dress tailored from cloth or soft leather. It covers the torso and legs against heat and cold, and is the most common everyday attire in elven settlements.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenDressTraditional_I.label: elven traditional dress I
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenDressTraditional_II.descriptio: An alternate cut of the one-piece elven dress. It offers the same coverage and insulation against heat and cold as the standard style, differing only in weave and silhouette.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenDressTraditional_II.label: elven traditional dress II
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenFlowerWreath.description: A brow wreath woven from fresh sprigs and wildflowers. Worn in the hair, it gives off a faint herbal scent and helps the wearer win goodwill in conversation.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenFlowerWreath.label: elven flower wreath
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenFormalGown.description: A layered ceremonial gown woven with fine gold thread, worn for festivals and diplomatic gatherings. It lends a poised, pleasing presence and carries weight in negotiations.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenFormalGown.label: elven formal gown
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenHunterUndershirt.description: A close-fitting underlayer worn beneath a cloak or light armor. Its taut fabric resists bunching in motion, helping the wearer evade blows in close combat.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenHunterUndershirt.label: elven hunter underlayer
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenLightArmor.description: Fitted armor favored by rangers, with chest and arm guards worn over an underlayer and an open skirt for a full stride. It adds no encumbrance, steadies ranged aim, and can be inscribed at an altar with a spell triggered when struck.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenLightArmor.label: elven light armor
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenMageRobe.description: An outer robe stitched along its seams with fine metallic thread, usually worn over an underlayer. It smooths the flow of mana within the body, helping sustain fuller reserves through prolonged fights.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenMageRobe.label: elven mage robe
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenSunHat.description: A broad-brimmed handwoven hat that shades the face outdoors and helps the wearer leave a warmer impression in conversation.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenSunHat.label: elven sun hat
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenTravelCloak.description: A full-length cloak fitted with pack straps, shielding everything below the head from wind, chill, and sun. The straps distribute weight so the wearer can carry more supplies.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenTravelCloak.label: elven travel cloak
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenTravelHood.description: A deep hood made to pair with the travel cloak, covering the entire head against cold winds and harsh sun.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenTravelHood.label: elven travel hood
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenWarArmor.description: Full metal plate fitted with pauldrons, standard issue for elven sword-guards and archons. It protects the whole body below the head at only a slight cost to speed, and can be inscribed at an altar with a spell triggered when struck.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenWarArmor.label: elven war armor
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenWarCrown.description: A winged war crown forged from a single piece of metal. Despite its open-faced design, its protection rivals a heavy helmet and shields the wearer's entire head.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenWarCrown.label: elven war crown
